contract.actions: Only server legalMoves and requestChoice; no browser rule checks or arbitrary client mechanics commands.

contract.cancellation: Optional effect choices cancel before mechanics writes; mandatory choices have no cancel. Printed action/card costs remain governed by their descriptor.
contract.guide: Existing setup/reference entry is reused and tested. Full eight-chapter TIC guide content remains P7.
contract.release: Test-only HTTP seed is confined to tools/tests. P4 opens no content; investigator and player availability are independently certified by P5 and P6. The campaign remains catalog-only.
